newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mixed as market tracks crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mixed as market tracks crude.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mixed after a volatile day spent tracking crude oil futures, traders said.

High sulphur barges rose and fell in line with futures, having been pushed up by a buyer to $87 fob ARA but failing to hold and trading mainly at $85. Low sulphur cargoes trailed behind firmer swaps and stuck at $87/$89 fob.
Gas oil was knocked up to $1.50 lower by weaker futures. Premiums held for most grades with barges 25 cents weaker.
Gasoline was steady, having traded as high as $195.50 fob in the morning and falling to $192 once IPE crude futures shed gains. Naphtha was also steady after a similarly volatile day.
